Priya Nair: Planning note for benchmark webinar + post. Need a tight unit-econ narrative: tokens -> $ conversion, latency SLO tradeoffs, and 3 simple visuals. Also routing rules for inbound leads. Keep it punchy.

Liam Ortiz: Thumbs up. My 3 visuals: 1) Cost density: $ per 1M tokens by model bucket (stacked bars with quantization effect as an overlay). 2) Latency p95 across deployment modes (mini heatmap). 3) SLO vs cost curve with a fallback annotation showing savings.

Noah Kim: For the cost chart, propose showing two columns per bucket: baseline (no batching) vs optimized (batch+quantize). Callout: realistic assumptions below the chart.

Zoe Grant: Messaging split: Startup headline = "See your tokens->dollars in 5 minutes" with CTA to run micro-benchmark. Enterprise headline = "Predictable latency & budgeting for mission-critical apps" with CTA to request capacity consult.

Priya Nair: Inbound routing: micro-benchmark runners -> SDR triage (warm); consult request -> AE/SE queue (high touch); webinar-only attendees -> nurture drip (3 emails). Capture chosen deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) on registration form and pipe to the queue.

Liam Ortiz: Design notes for chart copy (short):
- Cost clarity: $ per 1M tokens across model sizes — optimizing inference cuts spend up to ~6x.
- Reliable tails: p95 latency by deployment — dedicated keeps tails tight.
- Smart economics: SLO vs cost — fallbacks limit spend during spikes while keeping SLO.

bench-bot: Saved summary: https://internal.redwood/bench/launch-ops-playbook. Attached sample CSV and chart specs. :robot_face:

Priya Nair: Owners: Liam = chart copy + design mocks (Wed), Noah = sample CSV with illustrative calc (Wed), Zoe = CTA copy + routing mapping (Thu), I'll write the 90s demo script (Thu). We good?
